era: 2019 Verge (the 2016 Vox Media 'Chorus' design as it ran through 2019): black header with the white wordmark and condensed uppercase section nav (TECH, REVIEWS, SCIENCE, CREATORS, ENTERTAINMENT, VIDEO, FEATURES, PODCASTS, MORE) with magenta dropdown carets, a full-width glitch-art masthead on the home page, magenta and purple accents, bold Helvetica headlines on white, condensed uppercase section headings; the same page for every visitor (captures from 2019-03, 2019-07 and 2019-11 agree, and LaptopMag's 2019 Edge review shows the same page in a real browser).
